chunks: And when the emissaries are timed (or: when their time comes)

key_terms.أُقِّتَتْ: Were timed / Had their deadline set

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says 'And when the messengers are timed'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the accountability of the Prophets (peace be upon them) not for their own sins, but for the fidelity of their conveyance (tabligh) to their specific communities. The term 'uqqitat' signifies a fixed deadline for this reckoning, emphasizing that while the messengers are infallible in delivery, they will answer for whether the message was effectively transmitted and received. This event serves as a testament to the completeness of the divine mission before the final judgment of humanity.
